## Excluded GLM-5.3-Flash attempt

GLM-5.3-Flash is not included in the comparative harness results. The initial
2026-09-20 batch was not a valid model-quality measurement: Pi failed on an
incompatible request shape, while the original batch concurrency also triggered
Fireworks rate limiting [@pa1GlmConcurrencyFix]. Both issues were corrected
before a second max-reasoning attempt.

The corrected Fireworks-backed attempt still produced prolonged or repetitive
generations, widespread timeouts or incorrect task outcomes, and unusually high
token consumption. This consumed most of the remaining experiment budget
without producing a complete comparable matrix [@pa1GlmExclusion]. The observed
failure therefore cannot be attributed cleanly to the harnesses: within the
remaining budget it was not possible to determine whether the behavior was
intrinsic to GLM-5.3-Flash or specific to the Fireworks inference route. The
collected GLM data is retained as evidence of the failed experimental condition,
but it is excluded from the cross-harness performance and cost comparison. This
exclusion is based on the validity of the experimental condition, not on the
model's low task score.
